# Watchlist brief: 2026-09-24

## Market backdrop

## Notable moves

### AMZN: -5.46% (z-score -2.41, volume 1.93x normal)
- **What happened:** AMZN moved -5.46% on volume 1.93x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** AMZN fell 5.46%; its sector (Consumer Discretionary, XLY) fell 1.64% and the S&P 500 fell 1.01%. Part of the move matches its sector, but AMZN did 3.82 points worse: a wider gap than usual, though not an unusual one (z-score -1.9). Company news may explain the rest.
- **Likely why:** An analyst downgrade weighed on the shares. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-09-24/amzn-news)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

## Coming up

- Tue Sep 29: Apple (AAPL): Product launch event
- Wed Sep 30: NVIDIA (NVDA): Court hearing in patent case
